_doc: Oto AI golden eval cases. Each case: { name, description, vehicle_vin_tail? (default M550i N96146), disabled? (boolean), disabled_reason? (string), turns: [{user, expect}] }. Expect fields: tools_called (array, all must appear in any iter), branch (string, must match last iter), text_contains (string[], all must be present case-insensitive), text_not_contains (string[], none may be present), form_system (string, render_diagnostic_form.initialSystem must equal). Locked Principle #8: every prompt change debated against this set. Disabled cases are preserved verbatim — they record historical intent for future re-enablement once the underlying behavior is unblocked. The runner reports disabled cases separately from passed/failed (see oto-harness.html runEval).

cases.name: health_check_with_warning_light
cases.description: Decision D: explicit ask for score; warning-light interpretation must name finding, not enumerate mechanical causes. Multi-tool batching: should fire get_vehicle_health AND get_due_services together.

turns.user: How is my car doing?

cases.name: brake_self_reported_triggers_record_confirmation
cases.description: Trust protocol: on_time brakes + symptom contradicting + record_provenance=self_reported -> fires render_record_confirmation (NOT render_diagnostic_form). Replaces the v0.7 loophole-closure case (brake_narrowing_on_time_to_diagnostic) - the prior 'always force diagnostic form on on_time symptom' was overly strict; the real protocol gates on record provenance first. See docs/oto-ai/Trust_Protocol_Inflight_Handoff.md.

turns.user: My brakes have been squealing for a few weeks
Mostly when I first hit the brakes, then it goes quiet

cases.name: brake_record_confirmed_routes_to_diagnostic
cases.description: Trust protocol completion path: after the user confirms the self_reported record is correct, Oto's next turn routes to render_diagnostic_form (record was right, symptom is the surprise - let a mechanic look). Turn 3 simulates the mobile component's synthetic follow-up message that fires after the user taps 'Yes, that's right'.

turns.user: My brakes have been squealing for a few weeks
Mostly when I first hit the brakes, then it goes quiet
Confirmed - brakes record is correct as-is.

cases.name: polite_exit_after_vague_narrowing
cases.description: Symptom routing safety valve: when narrowing fails to converge after several vague exchanges, route to render_diagnostic_form with diagnostic_system='not_sure' (per the polite-exit rule).
cases.disabled_reason: Sprint 2 / Wave 7.x: the polite-exit counter (ai_conversations.diagnostic_turn_count, threshold=6) is incremented in chat.ts inside `if (!skipPersist)`. The harness defaults to debug_skip_persist=true, so the counter never advances and the 6th turn never fires the <polite_exit_required> envelope block. Two unblock paths: (A) decouple the counter from skipPersist (a chat.ts-only change, out of scope for the QA-lead adaptation dispatch), or (B) ship a harness-side seed mutation that sets diagnostic_turn_count=5 before the final turn (also touches convex/). Re-enable once either lands. Intent preserved verbatim — do not delete.
